post.title: The rate behind your mortgage just touched 5% again
post.ig:
The rate that steers mortgages touched 5% today.
The 10-year Treasury yield jumped to about 5.00% on Nov 10, 2026 after a hotter-than-expected October inflation report (CNBC).
Fed Governor Christopher Waller said a 50 basis point hike "should be considered" in December if inflation ran hot.
Freddie Mac's 30-year mortgage rate averaged 7.18% (week of Nov 5) vs 6.22% a year ago. On a $300,000 loan that's about $191 more a month (our math).
Sources: CNBC, Yahoo Finance, Freddie Mac.
News and education, not financial advice.
